subject: Re: Kickoff: Combiner for 32k-token serving
body:
Hi Priya,

Staffing: Yusuf Keita leads the benchmarking at 50%, Nikhil Abebe 30% on the eval harness, Leilani Nakamura 25% on the TF-side parity checks. For the serving handoff: Milan Zapata is committed at 60% to this project for June 2026 to drive the Shipyard integration — he's finishing another commitment in May, and June is when the integration work actually starts, so the timing lines up.

Compute: titan-a100 best-effort, 32 GPUs for the benchmark grid. The variants train on the same toy-through-medium configs, so no reservation needed.

One watch item: the JAX and TF implementations differ in which variants they expose (logn is JAX-only), so if logn wins the bake-off, TF parity becomes real work for Leilani.

Ivo
